pairs: Et reversus est angelus qui loquebatur in me,
And the angel who had been speaking with me returned,
et suscitavit me quasi virum qui suscitatur de somno suo.
and he awakened me, like a man who is awakened from his sleep.
and behold, a candlestick entirely in gold,
et lampas ejus super caput ipsius,
and its lamp was at its top,
et septem lucernæ ejus super illud,
and seven oil lamps of it were upon it,
et septem infusoria lucernis quæ erant super caput ejus.
and there were seven funnels for the oil lamps that were at its top.
And there were two olive trees upon it:
one to the right of the lamp,
et aio ad angelum qui loquebatur in me,
and spoke to the angel who was speaking with me,
Et respondit angelus qui loquebatur in me,
And the angel who was speaking with me answered,
“Do you not know what these are?”
Hoc est verbum Domini ad Zorobabel,
This is the word of the Lord to Zerubbabel,
And he will lead out the primary stone,
and he will give equal grace to its grace.
Et factum est verbum Domini ad me,
And the word of the Lord came to me,
The hand of Zerubbabel has founded this house,
and his hands will complete it.
et scietis quia Dominus exercituum misit me ad vos.
And you will know that the Lord of hosts has sent me to you.
For who has despised the little days?
Et lætabuntur, et videbunt lapidem stanneum in manu Zorobabel.
And they will rejoice and will see the silver and lead stone in the hand of Zerubbabel.
These are the seven eyes of the Lord,
which roam quickly through all the earth.
Et respondi, et dixi ad eum:
And I responded and said to him,
Quid sunt duæ olivæ istæ, ad dexteram candelabri,
“What are these two olive trees to the right of the candlestick,
Et respondi secundo, et dixi ad eum:
And I responded a second time and said to him,
Quid sunt duæ spicæ olivarum quæ sunt juxta duo rostra aurea in quibus sunt suffusoria ex auro?
“What are the two olive branches, which are next to the two golden ridges, in which are the pouring spouts of gold?”
“Do you not know what these are?”
“These are the two sons of oil,
who attend before the Sovereign of all the earth.”
